text: The police's part in the hollow: the weather, the coat, the matting, the bag, the tracks
why: The story so far mentions the heavy rain with no wind (¶95, ¶94) and Straker's coat hung on the furze-bush (¶35, ¶93), but it never mentions matting, a bag, or tracks in the hollow. The label points to details the story has not yet supplied.
